title: Thwomp
description:
This is a disassembly of sprite 26 in SMW - thwomp.

Comes with On/Off and mini versions by yoshicookiezeus.

On Extra Bit it'll move only on On/Off switch state, depending on variable.

(I know that there was mikeyk's disassembly, but I felt like making my own version)

Credit is optional.
